message: Done, with your guard, after the gather as you placed it (in find_decide() it would drop the --foreign shortcut's directories). Tested as a normal user on a 600 file owned by root: `! --mdt MDT0000` printed it before and prints nothing now. Found on the way: lfs never sets fp_exclude_mdt (-m sets fp_exclude_obd), so `! --mdt` is a no-op in stock lfs too. The test needed a patched lfs for that reason. I will file it separately.
